review_kind: Independent AI source-to-paper semantic review; not a human mathematical referee report
status: No discrepancy identified in the reviewed main theorem statements and underlying model/formula definitions; independent mechanical acceptance and publication verification are still pending.

findings: Parameters are natural n,k with only 1<=n and 1<=k, matching the paper's positive integer range. No stable-range n>=k assumption or spectral conclusion is supplied as a premise.

Physical states are rank-one projectors obtained from actual scalar-free signed Pauli subgroups of cardinality 2^n. POVMs have only positive effects and normalization; success is the mean trace Born score. The conclusion optimizes over every such POVM and includes attainment and minimax.
Ordinary eigenvalues expand to N/Z times stochastic isometry-group cardinality times F_r(2^(n+3-k)); Z is D times the product j=0..k-2 of (D+2^j). Exceptional values use exactly (k-1,r-1).
Numerical ordinary multiplicities match the odd, 2 mod 4, and 0 mod 4 formulas after m=floor(k/2)-r. Orthogonal and symplectic numerical factors have the standard explicit product orders.

Admissibility matches every plus/minus ordinary range and both exceptional ranges. Odd plus m=0 gives multiplicity D; even-zero plus terminal m=1 gives D^2-1; exceptional plus terminal gives 1. Excluded minus endpoints cannot enter the sector-label type.

All multiplicities are proved nonnegative integral physical ranks. Replicated multiset counts add coincident eigenvalues, drop zero multiplicities, and give all remaining zero eigenvalues. Finite success is exactly the normalized multiplicity-weighted square-root sum squared.
Universally quantified over every fixed integer c, with no asymptotic, normalization, summability or spectral hypotheses.
A and Q are the paper's infinite products with positivity and Multipliable conclusions; r is natural starting at zero, with u=2r-c.
W, Lambda_0, Lambda_r, F_r, and R_c match the paper literally. The c>=2 product is reindexed by j -> -j to a range of length c-1; c=1 is the empty product.
Both amplitude and first-moment summability are conclusions and the exact sum of W_r*Lambda_r is 1.

Convergence is proved both for the closed finite formula and the actual physical PGM success, with eventual optimality. Eventual positivity and exact integer identity of toNat(n+c) prevent negative-offset truncation from weakening the asymptotic statement.
The parameter-free theorem states both unit-ratio tail limits with the paper's exact scale constants.
The left tail denominator is 2^(-(m^2+3m+4)/2)/(A*Q), and the right tail denominator is 2^(-m).
Both natural and full integer m -> +infinity formulations are provided, over the same literal critical curve used in Theorem 2; there are no tail assumptions.
